binding_decisions: Historical branches are not merged into ROM-PURPOSE.
Reference Richards, RossFast, production groundwater coupling and production physics are read-only.
CURRENT_LAYER_FACE is the frozen first-discriminator Layer-ROM closure.
Application acceptance is not adjudicated without independent application authority.
Performance is out of scope until a hydrological purpose gate closes.

scientific_basis.state_information: L3 is only a bounded historical lower bound for predictive state information, not a generally adequate propagated model.
scientific_basis.placement: Historical evidence rejects uniform placement as a universal default and shows purpose-dependent upper- versus lower-zone sensitivity.
scientific_basis.closure: C6D supports missing subgrid shape as a mechanism on prescribed-head states, while C6E and C6J block promotion of the tested moment closures to a general free-running closure.
scientific_basis.surface: C6N2 shows that upper-zone placement materially changes surface/profile response and that numerical Reference uncertainty is not an application tolerance.
scientific_basis.root_feedback: C6P shows storage plus one centered geometric first moment is not generally sufficient for exact Feddes feedback; dynamic root uptake remains outside ROM-PURPOSE P1.
